Overall, the course requires consistent effort outside of class.

Simply put, I passed Calc III because of Weiss. Would HIGHLY recommend him for any math class

Professor Weiss is a very clear and engaging lecturer who provides extra videos when concepts need reinforcement. He is extremely accessible and genuinely cares about his students. When my friend and I emailed similar concerns, his detailed, thoughtful response stood out compared to a one-sentence reply from another professor.

I really enjoyed having Dr Weiss as a professor for Math215! He used drawings to explain a lot of concepts, and spent time making sure he explained concepts clearly. His office hours are also incredibly helpful for homework help or conceptual questions.

Professor Diaz is an amazing lecturer. She truly cares about the experience of her students and is really clear in how she teaches. The class was not the easiest, but she definitely made it more manageable. The class had a homework and a checkpoint every week, which sometimes took a bit of time.

Prof Diaz is an amazing lecturer and her annotated slides and handouts made difficult topics so much easier to understand!
